verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI app builder like Lovable, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out setting. Security scanners, audit logs, and credit-usage tracking are adjacent features and do not count as a user opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
